nativeRoute: Micro App Platform native login / versioned packages/sdk

loginFlow.steps: 内嵌应用优先复用主应用 utils.api，通过已核验的完整 user-info URL 验证会话；调用 getUserInfo 前须确认目标实现不会记录原始用户，不能仅凭 props 存在就调用。独立可信 Web 核实已部署授权码桥/OIDC、redirect 注册和 SDK。新 MCP 仅使用清单支持的 mcp-online-user 与显式 auth_profile=mcp-online-v1 的专用 online 用户 token，prepare 签名继承、confirm 拒绝 chat，fresh introspect；不得降级 PAT/legacy/chat/普通 session/Feishu fallback 或取 legacy config。后台服务身份按独立 profile 核验，不复制浏览器 JWT；候选源码不证明上述能力已部署。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: 平台用户 JWT、PAT、短时服务 JWT、SpiceDB secret 各自独立；Secret 只由后端注入链路提供。
subjectPermission: SDK trusted authn context and an explicit versioned subject mapping; metadata describes schema/static capabilities, not effective caller scopes, resource registration or SDK support. Verify resolved URLs and real allow/deny separately.
expiryRevoke: 依据已部署的 authentication/PAT OpenAPI；未证明上线的 capabilities/create/rotate/revoke 路由不得按候选源码直接使用。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.

referenceBase: owner-skill-root for SKILL.md/contractEntrypoints/referenceSources paths; contract field resolves from this JSON directory; upstream repository entrypoints stay repository-relative; sources.path resolves from this JSON directory
